title: Nehemiah Stops Oppression of the Poor

questions.question: Why was there a great outcry of the people?
options: They were mortgaging fields and borrowing money to buy food
questions.correctAnswer: They were mortgaging fields and borrowing money to buy food
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 5:1-3 (ESV): "...we are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses to get grain because of the famine."

questions.question: To whom were some of the sons and daughters forced into slavery?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 5:5 (ESV): "...we are forcing our sons and our daughters to be slaves..."

questions.question: Who did Nehemiah confront about this oppression?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 5:7 (ESV): "I took counsel with myself, and I brought charges against the nobles and the officials."

questions.question: What did Nehemiah say they were exacting?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 5:7 (ESV): "...You are exacting interest, each from his brother."

questions.question: What did Nehemiah command them to return?
options: Their fields, vineyards, olive orchards, and houses, and the interest
questions.correctAnswer: Their fields, vineyards, olive orchards, and houses, and the interest
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 5:11 (ESV): "Return to them this very day their fields..."

questions.question: How did the officials respond to Nehemiah's command?
options: We will restore these and require nothing from them
questions.correctAnswer: We will restore these and require nothing from them
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 5:12 (ESV): "Then they said, 'We will restore these and require nothing from them.'"

questions.question: What symbolic act did Nehemiah perform?
options: Shook out the fold of his garment
questions.correctAnswer: Shook out the fold of his garment
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 5:13 (ESV): "I also shook out the fold of my garment and said, 'So may God shake out every man from his house...'"

questions.question: Why did Nehemiah not demand the food allowance of the governor?
options: Because the service was too heavy on this people
questions.correctAnswer: Because the service was too heavy on this people
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 5:18 (ESV): "...Yet for all this I did not demand the food allowance of the governor, because the service was too heavy on this people."

questions.question: How many Jews and officials were at Nehemiah's table?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 5:17 (ESV): "Moreover, there were at my table 150 men, Jews and officials..."

questions.question: What was prepared for Nehemiah daily?
options: One ox and six choice sheep and birds
questions.correctAnswer: One ox and six choice sheep and birds
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 5:18 (ESV): "Now what was prepared at my expense for each day was one ox and six choice sheep and birds..."

questions.question: For how long did Nehemiah and his brothers not eat the food allowance?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 5:14 (ESV): "...from the twentieth year to the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king, twelve years, neither I nor my brothers ate the food allowance..."

questions.question: What did the former governors do?
options: Laid heavy burdens on the people and took food and wine and forty shekels of silver
questions.correctAnswer: Laid heavy burdens on the people and took food and wine and forty shekels of silver
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 5:15 (ESV): "The former governors... laid heavy burdens on the people and took from them food and wine, besides forty shekels of silver."

questions.question: Did Nehemiah acquire any land while governor?
options: No, we did not buy any land
questions.correctAnswer: No, we did not buy any land
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 5:16 (ESV): "I also persevered in the work on this wall, and we acquired no land..."

questions.question: Why did Nehemiah act differently than the former governors?
options: Because of the fear of God
questions.correctAnswer: Because of the fear of God
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 5:15 (ESV): "...But I did not do so, because of the fear of God."

questions.question: What is Nehemiah's concluding prayer in this chapter?
options: Remember for my good, O my God, all that I have done for this people
questions.correctAnswer: Remember for my good, O my God, all that I have done for this people
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 5:19 (ESV): "Remember for my good, O my God, all that I have done for this people."

key_verse_text: Return to them this very day their fields, their vineyards, their olive orchards, and their houses, and the percentage of money, grain, wine, and oil that you have been exacting from them.
